terms.comment: A description, a hold on which we place a foot: Traupman and Morgan–Owens have no word for a foothold on a climbing wall. In context ānsa alone will do (see climbing hold).

phrases.english: Put your foot on this hold.

sources: Lewis & Short: ansa · Lewis & Short: impono
L&S ansa documents handles and things taken hold of. The hold and route senses above are our semantic extensions.
